# Commercial Holiday Decor

> Commercial Holiday Decor supplies, installs, services and stores commercial-grade
> Christmas decor for commercial and municipal properties across Southwestern Ontario.
> Four product lines — commercial wreaths (3–8 ft, with the 4 ft as the standard for
> building fronts), mega trees (8–30 ft, with the 14 ft the most-specified size), large
> 2D/3D LED displays and photo-ops, and custom fabrication. Everything is quoted per
> property after a site walk rather than from a price list.

## Business details
- Name: Commercial Holiday Decor
- Based in: London, Ontario, Canada
- Phone: 519-266-6796
- Email: service@masterdecker.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8 AM–6 PM; 7 days during peak season
- Works on: commercial and municipal properties only (not residential)
- Service area: London, Kitchener-Waterloo, Windsor, Sarnia, Chatham, Woodstock,
  Stratford, St. Thomas, Brantford, Cambridge, Guelph, Tillsonburg and the rest of
  Southwestern Ontario

## Season
- Booking opens: June (book by June for a same-season install)
- Installation window: September through late November
- Takedown: January, included in the contract
- Off-season storage: included; decor is inspected, repaired and labelled by property

## Product lines
- Commercial Wreaths — /products/commercial-wreaths
  3 ft, 4 ft, 5 ft, 6 ft and 8 ft. Welded steel frames, UV-stable PVC tips, pre-lit
  commercial LED, weatherproof velvet bows, mounting hardware included.
- Mega Trees — /products/mega-trees
  8 ft to 30 ft. Sectional bolt-together steel frame, pre-strung commercial LED
  (warm white, multi or RGB), ballast or guy-wire anchoring, breaks down flat.
- Large Displays — /products/large-displays
  2D silhouette, 3D sculptural and walk-through photo-op pieces from 4 ft to 16 ft.
  Powder-coated steel frames, commercial LED, low-voltage distribution with timers.
- Custom Displays — /products/custom-displays
  Illuminated logos and wordmarks, entrance archways, themed photo-ops and one-off
  centrepieces. Concept → drawing → quote → fabrication → install.

## Services
- Design & site assessment — someone walks the property and measures before quoting
- Commercial installation — insured, WSIB-covered crews working from lifts
- In-season maintenance — outages, storm damage and timer faults, no trip charges
- Takedown & storage — January removal, inspection, repair and labelled storage

## Pricing
Priced per property, not per catalogue page. Frontage length, mounting height, power
availability, lift time and buy-versus-rent all change the total, so there are no list
prices on the site. Quotes are line-itemed across decor, install, in-season service and
takedown.
